name: Chapter select
description: An open book with embossed grey metal pages on a brown-and-gold binding: the right page is a track list of chapters in green and blue with times set right and the selected one on a red bar, and the left page has a raised title plate over a strip of rainbow blocks.
choices: The music disk’s menu of tunes becomes a contents page, so choosing a chapter looks like choosing a tune
Embossed grey, a red selection bar and a rainbow strip carry the 16-bit jukebox; the binding takes the brown and gold of the drawn cabinet
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
